visualRule.foliageDisplay: source-baked albedo with an alpha-tested depth pass and a 0.56–1.0 shadow mask; no second diffuse-light multiplication
visualRule.representativeRule: forest/scrub-only, source polygon contained, grass/sports/parking/buildings excluded; additional instances limited to camera-west half

parkingRule.overlapTest: entire car footprint inside source polygon, excludes buildings, and clears every mapped/generated tree or shrub by 2.5m
parkingRule.carShadowProxy: normalized source bounds, 12 triangles per vehicle; detailed source glTF remains visible and receives shadows but does not cast a second full-geometry shadow
